learning.instruction: Match the canonical watercolour and coloured-pencil technique closely: fine organic contours, uneven washes and gentle drawn volume. Keep accurate species, action contrasts, one counted object per item and exact answer colours. Use transparent square cells, generous gutters and complete silhouettes.

navigation.instruction: Use the same warm hand-drawn palette as a SIMPLE small pictogram. Follow the approved navigation-symbol reference for broad sepia outlines, bold silhouettes and nearly flat fills. Omit tiny scenery, stamps, material grain, fine hatching, glossy hubs and extra decoration. It must read at 32 pixels. This is a prescribed low-detail application of the canonical style. Preserve the existing den, door and back pictures by reuse when they are not the requested subject.

references.purpose: approved simplicity and silhouette reference for navigation; not a material-realism reference

stationery.instruction: Apply the canonical drawing technique to pale cream paper with restrained pencil borders and small leaf details. Keep clean empty space for the separately painted sender portrait. Genuine transparency surrounds the whole paper. Do not generate a substitute character or paint interface controls into the asset.

scene.instruction: Apply the canonical watercolour/pencil medium at landscape scale: broad quiet washes, restrained drawn detail at the edges, matte natural colours and soft organic contours. The scene is opaque. Keep the centre pale and calm for real panels and preserve required camera/layout anchors. Existing scene references define composition only; the canonical pair defines technique. Do not paint UI panels, text or characters into backgrounds.

branding.instruction: Use the canonical warm illustrated technique as a simple readable app emblem. Keep a clear silhouette and quiet background. A branding fox is not a replacement for the existing puzzle/map model portraits or the painted letter sender portraits.

letter-portrait.instruction: Paint recognizable sender friends in the canonical watercolour and coloured-pencil medium, with natural friendly animal proportions, organic sepia contours and gentle drawn volume. Keep species markings and identity accessories readable, with genuine transparency and complete silhouettes in generous square cells. Any model reference defines identity and colour only, never rendering style. This explicit painted-portrait role is for letters; existing world and puzzle/map identity pipelines remain separate.

cartography.instruction: Apply the canonical watercolour/pencil medium as a simplified flat cartographic plan. Strict orthographic top-down projection throughout, no perspective, visible vertical surfaces, relief modelling or cast shadows. Use broad quiet colour regions, light washes, fine organic sepia outlines and a few small plan-view symbols. Keep path connections, water boundaries and relative landmark positions clear; remove decorative microdetail. Opaque landscape canvas. Geography references define layout only. The result is a design proposal outside runtime assets until approved.
